component.name: RelayScene
component.script:
sub init() m.top.backgroundURI = "" m.top.backgroundColor = "0x281030FF" ' Roku key name -> tvui remote key name m.keys = { up: "Up", down: "Down", left: "Left", right: "Right", OK: "Confirm", back: "Return", replay: "Return", play: "PlayPause", rewind: "Rewind", fastforward: "Forward", options: "Options" } m.sender = CreateObject("roSGNode", "KeySender") m.sender.control = "RUN" m.top.setFocus(true) end sub
function onKeyEvent(key as String, press as Boolean) as Boolean name = m.keys[key] if press and name <> invalid and m.top.server <> "" then m.sender.server = m.top.server ' Stamp the press time (ms since epoch) so the server log can show end-to-end lag. now = CreateObject("roDateTime") ms = now.AsSeconds() * 1000& + now.GetMilliseconds() m.sender.key = name + "&t=" + ms.ToStr() end if ' Swallow everything we map, including back, so the relay keeps running. return name <> invalid end function
